versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
See AMC.609 Each part of the structure must
(a) Be suitably protected against deterioration or loss of strength in service due to any cause, including
  (1) Weathering;
  (2) Corrosion; and
  (3) Abrasion; and
(b) Unless it is detrimental to the function, there must be adequate provisions for ventilation and drainage.

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UA Design and Construction
versions.text:
See AMC.609 Each part of the structure must:
(a) Be suitably protected against deterioration or loss of strength in service due to any cause, including:
  (1) Weathering;
  (2) Corrosion; and
  (3) Abrasion; and
(b) Have adequate provisions for ventilation and drainage. Unless it is detrimental to the function, there must be adequate provisions for ventilation and drainage.
